item.text: {"iteration":2,"pcvs":[{"name":"new_block_count","expression":"max(0, num_full_blocks - num_cached_blocks)","rationale":"Models the dominant per-block hash insertion and loop cost."},{"name":"single_block_batch","expression":"int(num_full_blocks - num_cached_blocks == 1)","rationale":"Allows a separate offset for the one-block state, which the linear model substantially underpredicts."},{"name":"two_block_batch","expression":"int(num_full_blocks - num_cached_blocks == 2)","rationale":"Allows a separate offset for the two-block state, the other observed state with substantial unexplained cost."}],"hypothesis":"The remaining states follow an approximately linear per-block trend.
